pathforge_fit_adaptation: The outside demand is controlling visual prompt quality for generated imagery. This seed translates that need into a local offline creative QA board: a designer edits a campaign brief, compares four deterministic style directions, checks each against must-keep constraints, sees drift/conflict warnings, and copies/downloads a shot checklist. It does not generate images, call AI APIs, use remote assets, depend on hosted generators, or require multiple files.
final_artifact_clue: The default artifact title is Visual Consistency Board and the first viewport shows editable campaign brief fields, must-keep constraints, four style direction cards, drift warnings, and a shot checklist.
